blurb: Steal and Escape provides themed escape room games where teams solve puzzles and riddles to complete missions within 60 minutes. The games are designed for 2 to 8 players and recommended for ages seven and up. Each room offers a unique storyline and challenges that test problem-solving, teamwork, and creativity.
extraNote: Cancellations are not accepted · Private games only; never pair you with strangers · One group at a time; groups will not run into each other · Please arrive on time; cannot accommodate late arrivals · Must book at least 1 hour in advance; for last minute booking call
